title: The King's Heart

questions.question: The king's heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord; he turns it wherever he what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:1 (ESV): "he turns it wherever he will."

questions.question: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the Lord weighs what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:2 (ESV): "but the Lord weighs the heart."

questions.question: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:3 (ESV): "To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice."

questions.question: Haughty eyes and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, are what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:4 (ESV): "the lamp of the wicked, are sin."

questions.question: The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:5 (ESV): "but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty."

questions.question: It is better to live in a corner of the housetop than in a house shared with a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:9 (ESV): "than in a house shared with a quarrelsome wife."

questions.question: When a scoffer is punished, the simple becomes wise; when a wise man is instructed, he gains what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:11 (ESV): "when a wise man is instructed, he gains knowledge."

questions.question: Whoever closes his ear to the cry of the poor will himself call out and not be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:13 (ESV): "will himself call out and not be answered."

questions.question: A gift in secret averts anger, and a concealed bribe, strong what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:14 (ESV): "and a concealed bribe, strong wrath."

questions.question: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man; he who loves wine and oil will not be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:17 (ESV): "he who loves wine and oil will not be rich."

questions.question: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor and a snare of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:6 (ESV): "is a fleeting vapor and a snare of death."

questions.question: The violence of the wicked will sweep them away, because they refuse to do what is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:7 (ESV): "because they refuse to do what is just."

questions.question: The way of the guilty is crooked, but the conduct of the pure is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:8 (ESV): "but the conduct of the pure is upright."

questions.question: The righteous One observes the house of the wicked; he throws the wicked down to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:12 (ESV): "he throws the wicked down to ruin."

questions.question: The man who strays from the way of prudence will rest in the assembly of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 21:16 (ESV): "will rest in the assembly of the dead."

key_verse_text: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the Lord than sacrifice.
